sentences.japanese: 僕たちを外食に誘って下さい。
sentences.english: Please invite us out to dinner.

sentences.japanese: 海外旅行に誘われたけど、行きたくない。
sentences.english: I've been invited on a trip abroad, but I don't want to go.

sentences.japanese: 宇宙の果てへと私を誘う。
sentences.english: I am invited to the end of the universe.

sentences.japanese: ロバートはとても忙しかったのでゴルフの誘いを断らざるを得なかった。
sentences.english: Robert was so busy he had to turn down an invitation to play golf.

sentences.japanese: メアリーはコンサートの誘いを断った。
sentences.english: Mary declined an invitation to the concert.
